bugs.message: org.pangrova.indexing.api.data.BTreePage.rowPositions() may expose internal representation by returning BTreePage.rowPositions
org.pangrova.indexing.api.data.BloomFilterIndexData.filterData() may expose internal representation by returning BloomFilterIndexData.filterData
org.pangrova.indexing.api.data.bitmap.BitmapIndexData.bitmaps() may expose internal representation by returning BitmapIndexData.bitmaps
org.pangrova.indexing.api.data.spatial.BoundingBox.maxValues() may expose internal representation by returning BoundingBox.maxValues
org.pangrova.indexing.api.data.spatial.BoundingBox.minValues() may expose internal representation by returning BoundingBox.minValues
org.pangrova.indexing.api.data.text.GinIndexData.elementPostings() may expose internal representation by returning GinIndexData.elementPostings
org.pangrova.indexing.api.data.text.NGramBloomIndexData.filterData() may expose internal representation by returning NGramBloomIndexData.filterData
org.pangrova.indexing.api.statistics.DynamicFilterSummary$ColumnRangeSummary.bloomFilter() may expose internal representation by returning DynamicFilterSummary$ColumnRangeSummary.bloomFilter
org.pangrova.indexing.api.statistics.RowGroupSkipInfo.skippedGroups() may expose internal representation by returning RowGroupSkipInfo.skippedGroups

scope: Verify stops on nine findings. Source review separates mutable representations from likely immutable-collection analysis limitations; none is excluded or declared fixed in this batch.

source_review.BTreePage.rowPositions: Nested lists are copied to immutable lists; likely analyzer limitation on Stream.toList. Needs caller-mutation regressions before classification, not a blanket clone change.
source_review.GinIndexData.elementPostings: String keys and nested Integer lists are copied before Map.copyOf; likely analyzer limitation on helper-returned immutable map. Verify rather than weakening globally.
source_review.BitmapIndexData.bitmaps: Constructor copies map and byte arrays; generated accessor exposes mutable byte-array values.
source_review.RowGroupSkipInfo.skippedGroups: Constructor clones BitSet, generated accessor exposes owned BitSet; includes shared NONE instance.
Non-null input byte array is retained and returned directly; both input/output ownership require review.
source_review.BloomFilterIndexData.filterData: Explicit raw-array borrowing for hot evaluation; protect public representation without introducing repeated MB-size copies in evaluators.
source_review.NGramBloomIndexData.filterData: Same deliberate hot-path raw array as Bloom; inspect codecs and real evaluators before replacement.
source_review.BoundingBox.minValues/maxValues: Immutable claim conflicts with raw mutable array accessors; inspect dimension/serialization consumers.
